product_overview: Acodera CRM is a multi-tenant customer relationship management platform for small and medium businesses to manage contacts, sales pipelines, automations, invoicing, event tickets, reviews, and analytics from one dashboard. It also includes admin tools for user, API key, audit log, and payment gateway management.
core_goals: Authenticate into the CRM and access the main dashboard
Manage customer contacts across the CRM
Track deals through a visual sales pipeline
Create, preview, customize, and manage invoices
Create and manage event tickets and ticket instances
Collect and respond to customer reviews
View business metrics and trends in analytics dashboards
Restore or permanently delete previously removed items
Administer users, API keys, audit logs, and payment gateway settings

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Allows users to log in or register before accessing the dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email and password -> Submit the login form -> See the dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Switch to registration form -> Fill in name, email, and password -> Submit the registration form -> See the dashboard

features.name: Dashboard Home
features.description: Shows a high-level summary of CRM activity and business performance.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View total contacts, flows, invoices, and reviews counts -> View revenue chart -> View flow stage distribution -> View recent reviews

features.name: Contact Management
features.description: Lets users search, create, update, and delete customer contacts.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/contacts -> Search for a contact -> View the filtered contact list
Navigate to /dashboard/contacts -> Start adding a new contact -> Fill in contact details -> Submit the form -> See the new contact in the list
Navigate to /dashboard/contacts -> Open a contact for editing -> Update contact details -> Save changes -> See the updated contact in the list
Navigate to /dashboard/contacts -> Select a contact for deletion -> Confirm deletion -> See the contact removed from the list

features.name: Pipeline Management (Flows)
features.description: Provides a Kanban-style sales pipeline for tracking and updating deals.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/flow -> View the Kanban board -> Review deal cards across stages
Navigate to /dashboard/flow -> Drag a deal to a different stage -> See the deal move to the new stage
Navigate to /dashboard/flow -> Start adding a new deal -> Fill in deal details -> Submit the form -> See the new deal on the board
Navigate to /dashboard/flow -> Open a deal for editing -> Update deal details -> Save changes -> See the updated deal card
Navigate to /dashboard/flow -> Select a deal for deletion -> Confirm deletion -> See the deal removed from the board

features.name: Automation Engine
features.description: Enables users to create email automation campaigns, manage their status, and review logs.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/automation -> View the automation campaigns list -> Review campaign status and details
Navigate to /dashboard/automation/new -> Fill in automation name, trigger event, and schedule -> Submit the form -> See the new automation in the list
Navigate to /dashboard/automation -> Select an automation -> Toggle its active status -> See the status change
Navigate to /dashboard/automation/:id -> View automation logs -> Review recent automation activity

features.name: Invoicing & Payments
features.description: Lets users manage invoices, preview them, download them, and view payment information.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/invoicing -> Search and filter invoices by status -> View the invoice list
Navigate to /dashboard/invoicing/new -> Fill in customer information, invoice items, and payment method -> Submit the form -> See the new invoice in the list
Navigate to /dashboard/invoicing/:id -> Preview the invoice as a printable document -> Download it as PNG or PDF
Navigate to /dashboard/invoicing/:id -> Open payment information -> View QR code or bank and e-wallet payment details
Navigate to /dashboard/invoicing/template -> Update logo, company details, accent color, tax rate, and footer text -> Preview template changes -> Save the template

features.name: Event Tickets
features.description: Supports creating ticket types and reviewing ticket instances for events.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/tickets -> Search the ticket list -> View matching tickets
Navigate to /dashboard/tickets/new -> Fill in ticket title, price, date, time, and location -> Submit the form -> See the new ticket type in the list
Navigate to /dashboard/tickets/:id -> View ticket instances -> Review sold ticket records
Navigate to /dashboard/tickets -> Select a ticket for deletion -> Confirm deletion -> See the ticket removed from the list

features.name: Customer Reviews
features.description: Allows users to view, add, reply to, update, and delete customer reviews.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/reviews -> View the customer reviews list -> Review ratings and feedback
Navigate to /dashboard/reviews -> Add a new review manually -> Fill in reviewer name, rating, and text -> Submit the form -> See the review in the list
Navigate to /dashboard/reviews -> Open a review reply flow -> Write a reply -> Save the reply -> See the reply attached to the review
Navigate to /dashboard/reviews -> Select a review for deletion -> Confirm deletion -> See the review removed from the list

features.name: Analytics Dashboard
features.description: Displays charts and metrics for revenue, deals, contacts, and reviews.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/analytics -> View revenue trends over time -> View deal stage distribution -> View contact growth -> View review rating distribution

features.name: Trash / Soft Delete
features.description: Shows deleted items and lets users restore or permanently remove them.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/trash -> Switch between entity tabs -> View deleted contacts, automations, flows, invoices, and tickets
Navigate to /dashboard/trash -> Select a deleted item -> Restore it -> See the item return to its original list
Navigate to /dashboard/trash -> Select a deleted item -> Permanently delete it -> See the item removed from trash

features.name: User Management
features.description: Gives owner users administrative control over platform users.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/admin/users -> View all users in the list -> Review roles and branch assignments
Navigate to /dashboard/admin/users -> Start creating a new user -> Fill in user details and role -> Submit the form -> See the new user in the list
Navigate to /dashboard/admin/users -> Open a user for editing -> Update user details or role -> Save changes -> See the updated user record
Navigate to /dashboard/admin/users -> Select a user for deletion -> Confirm deletion -> See the user removed from the list

features.name: API Key Management
features.description: Lets users create and revoke API keys for external access.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/admin/api-keys -> View the API keys list -> Review key names, prefixes, and status
Navigate to /dashboard/admin/api-keys -> Start creating a new API key -> Enter a name and rate limit -> Submit the form -> View the full key once
Navigate to /dashboard/admin/api-keys -> Select an API key for revocation -> Confirm revocation -> See the key disabled in the list

features.name: Audit Logs
features.description: Provides a filtered log viewer and summary statistics for system activity.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/admin/audit-logs -> View audit log entries -> Move through paginated results -> Review recent activity
Navigate to /dashboard/admin/audit-logs -> Filter logs by action type -> Filter logs by entity type -> View the narrowed results
Navigate to /dashboard/admin/audit-logs -> View audit statistics -> Review today, last 30 days, and action-based summaries

features.name: Payment Gateway Configuration
features.description: Allows administrators to configure, enable, view, and disable a payment gateway provider.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/admin/gateway -> Select a payment gateway provider -> Enter gateway configuration details -> Save and enable the gateway
Navigate to /dashboard/admin/gateway -> View the webhook URL -> Copy or note the endpoint for external setup
Navigate to /dashboard/admin/gateway -> Disable the payment gateway -> See the gateway configuration removed or turned off

features.name: Invoice Template Customization
features.description: Lets users customize invoice branding and layout settings.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/invoicing/template -> Upload a company logo -> Update company name, address, email, phone, and website -> Preview the template changes in real time
Navigate to /dashboard/invoicing/template -> Change the accent color -> Adjust the tax rate -> Update footer text -> Review the updated invoice appearance

known_limitations.issue: Invoicing, Tickets, and some other features use mock data instead of real backend API calls
known_limitations.impact: Invoice, ticket, and some other data is simulated and not persisted via the REST API

known_limitations.issue: Invoice template customization template field uses JSON column in MySQL
known_limitations.impact: PostgreSQL syntax ::jsonb used in gatewayConfig.js line 69 may cause issues with MySQL

known_limitations.issue: Gateway config delete route uses PostgreSQL jsonb syntax
known_limitations.impact: Will fail on MySQL since ::jsonb cast syntax is PostgreSQL-specific

known_limitations.issue: No dedicated invoices or tickets tables/routes on the backend
known_limitations.impact: Invoicing, ticket CRUD, and analytics data are entirely client-side via mockData.js using Supabase

known_limitations.issue: Refresh/loading states could be improved across the app
known_limitations.impact: Some pages lack loading skeletons and error boundary handling

known_limitations.issue: Soft delete (trash) uses mockData functions and only works client-side
known_limitations.impact: Trash data is ephemeral and lost on page refresh
